items.titleArabic: تحديد الأعراض الأولية في الاختبار الميداني
items.titleEnglish: Identifying initial symptoms during field testing
items.contentMarkdown:
موضوع اليوم (بالعربية): تدريب عملي على وصف الأعراض الأولية عند فحص نظام كهربائي ميداني، وتسجيل ما رأيته باستخدم الماضي البسيط، وعبارات التسلسل، وعبارات السبب والنتيجة.

Target words (exactly five) with Arabic translations:
- symptom — عَرَض
- inspection — فَحْص
- voltage — فُولْتِيّ/فولتاج
- sequence — تَتَابُع
- recorded — مُسَجَّل (الماضي)

Practice modes (simple English prompts):
- 5-minute mode: Roleplay a quick field check. You are the engineer. Say two short sentences describing one symptom and one immediate check you did. Use past simple once.
- 10-minute mode: Roleplay a short handover to your colleague. Describe three steps you performed in sequence, report one measurement (voltage), and one result. Use past simple and sequence markers (first, then, finally).
- 13-minute mode: Full roleplay plus short written log. Describe symptoms, list three checks you performed with results, give a short cause-and-effect conclusion, and write a one-paragraph test log in past simple.

Ask one question at a time.

10-point rubric (scale for fluency, vocabulary, grammar, clarity):
1–2: Very poor — halting, wrong words, many grammar errors, unclear.
3–4: Poor — slow, limited vocabulary, frequent grammar mistakes, message often unclear.
5–6: Fair — understandable, limited vocabulary, some past-simple errors, basic clarity.
7–8: Good — generally fluent, correct past simple, appropriate sequence words, clear conclusions.
9–10: Excellent — smooth, precise technical words, correct cause-effect language, concise clear report.

Corrective examples:
1) Incorrect: "I check the voltage and it show low." Correct: "I checked the voltage and it showed low." (السبب: استخدام الماضي البسيط للملاحظات المسجلة.)
2) Incorrect: "First I tested, then I was measure current." Correct: "First I tested the supply, then I measured the current." (السبب: ترتيب الأحداث واستخدام الماضي البسيط.)
3) Incorrect: "Because the cable broken, the panel not start." Correct: "The cable was broken, so the panel did not start." (السبب: صياغة السبب والنتيجة وشكل الماضي.)

موضوع اليوم (بالعربية): تعلم وصف خطوات فحص الطاقة واختبار استمرارية الأسلاك وتوثيق النتائج بصيغة الماضي البسيط، مع استخدام عبارات تسلسل وشرط عملي بسيط.

Target words (exactly five) with Arabic translations:
- continuity — استمرارية
- probe — مسبار/مشبك الاختبار
- reading — قِرَاءَة (قِيَمَة)
- isolated — مُعْزول
- clamp — مِقْبَض/مِلاقط

Practice modes (simple English prompts):
- 5-minute mode: Describe one continuity check you performed: what you touched with the probe and the reading you saw. Use past simple.
- 10-minute mode: Explain two power checks in order (first..., then...), mention instruments (probe, clamp) and the readings. State if you isolated the circuit.
- 13-minute mode: Roleplay a short safety report. Say what you isolated, how you tested continuity, give numeric readings, and end with a conditional sentence describing what you would do if a wire had no continuity.

Ask one question at a time.

10-point rubric (scale for fluency, vocabulary, grammar, clarity):
1–2: Very poor — cannot describe checks, wrong terms, grammar breaks meaning.
3–4: Poor — limited steps, incorrect past forms, unclear results.
5–6: Fair — basic steps correct, some past simple errors, readings included but brief.
7–8: Good — clear sequence, correct readings, correct conditional for action.
9–10: Excellent — accurate technical words, correct past simple and conditionals, clear safety action.

Corrective examples:
1) Incorrect: "I isolate the circuit then I test continuity." Correct: "I isolated the circuit, then I tested continuity." (السبب: استخدام الماضي عند وصف إجراءات مكتملة.)
2) Incorrect: "The probe show zero ohm so it good." Correct: "The probe showed zero ohms, so it was good." (السبب: زمن الماضي و agreement وplural for units.)
3) Incorrect: "If wire not continuous, I shut it off." Correct: "If the wire was not continuous, I would shut it off." (السبب: شرط عملي مع نتيجة محتملة وصيغة صحيحة.)

items.titleArabic: قراءة رموز الخطأ وصياغة ملخص مختصر
items.titleEnglish: Reading error codes and writing a concise summary
items.contentMarkdown:
موضوع اليوم (بالعربية): فهم وقراءة رمز/رموز الخطأ، وصف الأعراض المرتبطة، وتلخيص الإجراء التصحيحي في جمل بسيطة بالماضي البسيط مع توضيح السبب والنتيجة.

Target words (exactly five) with Arabic translations:
- error code — رمز خطأ
- logged — مُسَجَّل
- cleared — مُسْتَأْنَف/مُسْتَخْلَص (الماضي: تم مسحه)
- indicator — مُؤَشِّر
- cause — سَبَب

Practice modes (simple English prompts):
- 5-minute mode: Say the error code you saw and one symptom that matched. Use past simple.
- 10-minute mode: Explain how you read the code, where it was logged, what indicator lit, and one corrective action you took. Use past simple and cause-effect language.
- 13-minute mode: Roleplay reporting to a supervisor: list codes, describe tests you did, state the likely cause, and write a two-sentence corrective action plan in past simple and a practical conditional for follow-up.

Ask one question at a time.

10-point rubric (scale for fluency, vocabulary, grammar, clarity):
1–2: Very poor — cannot report codes or actions clearly.
3–4: Poor — codes mentioned but grammar prevents clear meaning.
5–6: Fair — codes and actions present, some past tense errors.
7–8: Good — clear code reading, proper past simple, logical cause-effect.
9–10: Excellent — precise reporting, concise corrective plan, clear conditional follow-up.

Corrective examples:
1) Incorrect: "The error code was 404 and I clear it." Correct: "The error code was 404 and I cleared it." (السبب: استخدام الماضي للأفعال المسجلة.)
2) Incorrect: "The indicator blink, then the machine stop." Correct: "The indicator blinked, then the machine stopped." (السبب: الأفعال في الماضي والتتابع.)
3) Incorrect: "Because fuse blown, machine had no power." Correct: "Because the fuse had blown, the machine had no power." (السبب: زمن الماضي التام للسبب قبل النتيجة، حيث يلزم للتسلسل.)

موضوع اليوم (بالعربية): شرح إجراءات العزل الآمن لموقع العمل، وصف ما عزلته ولماذا، وتوثيق الإجراءات باستخدام الماضي البسيط وعبارات السبب والنتيجة.

Target words (exactly five) with Arabic translations:
- isolate — يعزل/عَزَلَ (فعل)
- locked — مُقْفَل/مُقَفَّل (الماضي)
- tag — وَسْم/تَاغ
- verification — تَحَقُّق
- procedure — إِجْرَاء/إِرْشَاد

Practice modes (simple English prompts):
- 5-minute mode: Say one sentence: what you isolated and why. Use past simple.
- 10-minute mode: Describe the isolation procedure you followed in three steps and how you verified the isolation.
- 13-minute mode: Roleplay a short safety briefing to a new technician: explain the lock/tag steps, what you recorded, and a conditional sentence about what to do if verification failed.

Ask one question at a time.

10-point rubric (scale for fluency, vocabulary, grammar, clarity):
1–2: Very poor — unsafe wording, wrong tenses, unclear procedure.
3–4: Poor — steps incomplete, grammar errors obscure meaning.
5–6: Fair — basic procedure present, some past-simple mistakes.
7–8: Good — clear lock/tag steps, correct past simple, clear verification.
9–10: Excellent — concise safety language, correct conditionals, very clear instructions.

Corrective examples:
1) Incorrect: "I isolate the panel and left it." Correct: "I isolated the panel and locked it." (السبب: زمن الماضي وصياغة الإجراء الأمني.)
2) Incorrect: "We tag it then we verify." Correct: "We tagged it, then we verified." (السبب: تتابع الأحداث في الماضي.)
3) Incorrect: "If verification fail, we continue." Correct: "If verification failed, we would stop work." (السبب: صياغة شرط عملي لرد فعل آمن.)

items.titleArabic: تحليل السبب الجذري وخطة الإجراء التصحيحي
items.titleEnglish: Root-cause analysis and corrective action plan
items.contentMarkdown:
موضوع اليوم (بالعربية): كتابة وصف واضح للسبب الجذري لمشكلة فنية وما فعلته لتصحيحها، مع توثيق سجل الاختبار بالماضي البسيط، وشرح السبب والنتيجة وشرط عملي للوقاية المستقبلية.

Target words (exactly five) with Arabic translations:
- root cause — السبب الجذري
- corrective action — إجراء تصحيحي
- implemented — نَفَّذْتُ/تَمَّ تَنْفِيذُه (الماضي)
- prevented — مَمْنُوع/مَانَع (الماضي)
- follow-up — مُتابَعَة

Practice modes (simple English prompts):
- 5-minute mode: State the root cause and one corrective action you implemented. Use past simple.
- 10-minute mode: Describe the analysis steps you used (for example, five whys), what you implemented, and one result you recorded.
- 13-minute mode: Write a short corrective action plan: list the root cause, steps implemented, test results in past simple, and a conditional statement about follow-up checks.

Ask one question at a time.

10-point rubric (scale for fluency, vocabulary, grammar, clarity):
1–2: Very poor — cannot identify cause or action clearly.
3–4: Poor — weak link between cause and action, grammar errors.
5–6: Fair — cause and action present, past simple errors, limited clarity.
7–8: Good — clear root-cause language, correct past simple, logical corrective steps.
9–10: Excellent — concise analysis, precise corrective actions, clear follow-up conditional.

Corrective examples:
1) Incorrect: "The cause was loose wire, we fix it." Correct: "The cause was a loose wire; we fixed it." (السبب: فصل الجمل وتوحيد الزمن الماضي.)
2) Incorrect: "I implement new bracket and it prevent future failure." Correct: "I implemented a new bracket and it prevented future failure." (السبب: الماضي لكل الأداء المسجل.)
3) Incorrect: "If we do check, we find problem." Correct: "If we checked, we would find the problem." (السبب: شرط عملي لصياغة نتيجة محتملة.)

موضوع اليوم (بالعربية): كيفية كتابة سجل اختبار مهني ومختصر بعد إجراء فحوصات، استخدام الماضي البسيط لملخص الأفعال، وعبارات التسلسل والتوضيح المختصر للنتائج والإجراءات.

Target words (exactly five) with Arabictranslations:
- test log — سجل اختبار
- timestamp — طابع زمني/تاريخ ووقت
- result — نَتِيجَة
- concise — مُختَصَر
- signed — وَقَّعْتُ/مُوَقَع (الماضي)

Practice modes (simple English prompts):
- 5-minute mode: Say one short test-log sentence: time, test, and result in past simple.
- 10-minute mode: Produce three short log lines: timestamp, action, numeric result, and signature line in past simple.
- 13-minute mode: Create a complete short test log for a fault finding: list steps in sequence, measurements, conclusion, and a follow-up instruction using a practical conditional.

Ask one question at a time.

10-point rubric (scale for fluency, vocabulary, grammar, clarity):
1–2: Very poor — log unreadable or missing key elements.
3–4: Poor — missing timestamps or incorrect tenses.
5–6: Fair — basic log present, some grammar/timing errors.
7–8: Good — clear concise log, correct past simple, proper timestamps.
9–10: Excellent — professional concise log, precise numbers, clear follow-up conditional.

Corrective examples:
1) Incorrect: "09:00 I test supply and ok." Correct: "09:00 I tested the supply and it was OK." (السبب: زمن الماضي والتفاصيل.)
2) Incorrect: "Result 5 amp, sign." Correct: "Result: 5 A; signed: A. Khan." (السبب: تنسيق المعلومة واستخدام الماضي للوقائع.)
3) Incorrect: "If problem appear again, call us." Correct: "If the problem appears again, call us immediately." (السبب: تصحيح الزمن ووضوح الإجراء.)

موضوع اليوم (بالعربية): ممارسة الحوار المهني مع الفريق أو المورد أثناء استكشاف الأعطال: وصف الأعراض، ما اختبرته، السبب المحتمل، والإجراء المُتَّخَذ بصيغة الماضي البسيط، مع استخدام شروط عملية للتصرف.

Target words (exactly five) with Arabic translations:
- reported — أُبْلِغَ/أَخْبَرْتُ (الماضي)
- diagnosis — تَشْخِيص
- escalate — صَعَّدَ/رَفَعَ المَسْأَلَة
- confirmation — تَأْكِيد
- actioned — نُفّذ (الماضي)

Practice modes (simple English prompts):
- 5-minute mode: Roleplay a short call: say one sentence about what was reported and one test result in past simple.
- 10-minute mode: Simulate a conversation with a supplier: describe diagnosis steps, what you actioned, and ask for confirmation in sequence.
- 13-minute mode: Full roleplay of a team meeting: present the fault, what you tested (past simple), your root cause, the corrective action you actioned, and a conditional plan if the fault returns.

Ask one question at a time.

10-point rubric (scale for fluency, vocabulary, grammar, clarity):
1–2: Very poor — unclear communication, wrong tenses, no clear request.
3–4: Poor — basic message but grammar and vocabulary limit clarity.
5–6: Fair — message delivered, some past-simple or conditional errors.
7–8: Good — professional tone, correct past simple and conditional, clear requests.
9–10: Excellent — concise, polite, correct technical language, clear follow-up actions.

Corrective examples:
1) Incorrect: "The operator reported alarm, I check and fix." Correct: "The operator reported an alarm; I checked and fixed it." (السبب: استخدام الماضي البسيط وتوضيح الأفعال.)
2) Incorrect: "I escalated to vendor and he not reply." Correct: "I escalated to the vendor, and he did not reply." (السبب: الماضي والتركيب الصحيح.)
3) Incorrect: "If it fail again, we escalate." Correct: "If it fails again, we will escalate to the vendor immediately." (السبب: شرط عملي وصيغة مستقبلية مناسبة للقرار.)
